frustrating.reason: The challenges were all straightforward and fair, with no unfair traps or unavoidable damage moments.

surprising.reason: The level used very standard enemies and block placements without introducing any novel combinations or unique ideas.

design.reason: The design feels disjointed, with long empty sections and random enemy placement rather than a cohesive flow.
